scope: Read-only retained-evidence diagnosis for the tested STAGE/FULL archive and persistence cases, under fixed trusted roots and no concurrent writer.
findings: F1-F3 and archive F4 were closed by independent source review. Root confirms the final F5 guard precedes native parsing and reuses bounded parsed data; two independent embedded-resource cases pass. Final negative tests cover unknown/orphan inventory, duplicate history including malformed selected history, and fully relinked contradictory receipt identities.
behavior: No input writes, lock release, repair, consumption reset, transport or authority generation.
Missing, retained-but-unbound and bound recorded evidence remain distinct. Aggregate digest and whole-result digest remain separate.
Native pass and local aggregate result remain separate recorded assertions. Terminal RELEASE with an extant lock is not physical release proof.
Changed reads produce UNSTABLE and clear dependent bindings without retry. Unknown historical archives remain unknown; valid duplicate findings survive malformed readable history.
Exact bounded JSON validation covers archive certificates/pins and embedded stdout before native parsing.
limits: Two matching passes establish observed stability only, not an atomic or hostile-filesystem guarantee.
Global resource or unreadable-file failure may abort the history scan; it never certifies absence.
FULL held-lock evidence uses a disclosed synthetic reconstruction from an accepted completed controller fixture, not an actual process crash.
Not every receipt variant/mode, optional hint, malformed input or resource-limit cross-product was executed. Process-kill and power-loss durability remain unproved.
Author v10 detailed resource results were overwritten and replaced by a disclosed compact account; that account is not counted as independent retained test evidence.
External PLAN/consumption backing proof, current host effects, fresh owner authority and a reviewed effectful recovery packet remain required. Real adapter/mainCLI stay locked.
next: Verify the remaining synthetic recovery paths through the persistent FULL controller; owner-present measurement and final Preflight remain gated.
